format: Standard ONNX opset17; domains empty/ai.onnx only; FP32 original438 softmax; no custom Windows op
dictionary: dictionary.json: blank0; original official character_dict then final space437, total438; full softmax without ASCII renormalization
preprocess: Exact reference image_tensor.py tensor(): nonwhite whole-line bbox+2originalpx externally; preserve crop origin/baseline/relative heights/internal gaps; original-pixel center bilinear and uint8 rounding before BGR normalization, pad normalized0; validWidth actual resampled width; widths outside320..960 rejected, never silently stretched
ctc: greedy argmax, blank removed, adjacent same-class run collapses, piece confidence is maximum class probability across run; native source endpoints based on original inputWidth/T. interval End*inputWidth > validWidth*T is unsupported padding and refused, never clamped. Source offset maps through supplied crop rect.
diagnosticAcceptance: Nonempty printableASCII, minimum emitted CTC confidence>=.8, reject_probability<=.05, no unsupported CTC interval. These are uncalibrated diagnostics, not permission to auto-adopt or proof of input/source completeness.
safetensors: adapter-state.safetensors includes official.* and reject.* keys; load strictly through Adapter. It is not an unmodified official HF state dict. Standard ONNX consumers do not need PyTorch/Transformers.
platformLimits: Linux ORT CPU validation only; no native Windows throughput/full-document qualification or CoreML/iPhone execution. iOS repository untouched. Model publication/active product switch requires separate parent decision.
